items.text: Kotukonokis Ipilisitian ajorekee ejie, kotukokinos Soko, naka Yuda, kidukuroto kidin Soko ka Aseka, toma Epes-damim,
Kotukokinos Saul ka ituŋa luka Isirael, kidukuroto apuuton naka Ela, kiderakinos ejie ka Ipilisitian.
Kobwaata Ipilisitian komoru epuai, kobwaata luka Isirael da komoru kepuai: koiai aditot kidinikec,
Kolom ekadedenan koswamin luka Ipilisitian, ekekiror Goliat, loka Gas, aoiauke ikubitin
Konapite aboko naka aisinit kakouke, konapite da ekooti loka aisinit; alaŋir naka ekooti isekelin ilukumin ikany luka aisinit.
Konapite da kakeje aisinit, ka eliru loka aisinit kopur.
Koputos amorok naka akwarake bala akitoi naesonyere; ka akwarake da alopet alaŋir kitemi isekelin akwat akanykape luka asuat: kinarenenokini ŋol lokitinenenei ekebuku.
Kobwo kiworo mama ejai ajore naka Isirael, kobala ebe, “Kanukinyo ilomuniata aiderakin? Mere eoŋ Epilisitiat, yes da ibulesin luka Saul? Koseutu ekes kanukus, kikokoroun neajai,
Arai kepedo ejie keoŋ, kaar, asa kiluor isio ikusibulesin; konye keteleka eoŋ ŋes, kaar, asa iluoros yesi ibulesinikosi, kijaanakinete sio.”
Kiner Epilisitiat ebe, “Emua lolo ajore naka Isirael; ae ekes, kaiioto.”
Kiira Saul ka luka Isirael kere akiro ŋun nuka Epilisitiat, kiyalononoto, kokuriakaros noi.
Kerai Daudi okoku loka Epurasit ŋol loka Bet-lekem-Yuda, lokerai ekekiror Yese; kejaas odweke ikanykauni: komoionite da etuŋanan ŋol kapaarasia nuka Saul, kokokosanite kotuna.
Ketuparito odwe luka Yese lukapolok iuni Saul oiie: ikiroria da luka odweke luuni lukelositos oiie kes luta, ekiyai ŋes Eliab, loketupi da ŋes Abinadab, ka lokiwuniet ŋes Sama,
Daudi ŋes eŋoorit: ketuparito lukapolok iuni Saul.
Ido kobononori Daudi kama ejai Saul acok amerekekin nuka papake Bet-lekem.
Kikunyununei Epilisitiat tupuruc ka eboŋ, kitodianar apaarasia akaisaoŋon.
Kolimok Yese okokuke Daudi che, “Koina bo ikoniinacan epa
loka imomwa luikawooritai, ka imugatin lu itomon, kisunya ayaŋaar oidukurun mama ejaas ikoniinaean:
Koina ekapolon loka elukumitikee ikamonon itomon lueokito luka akile, koany kwape ejaatar ikoniinaean, kijau aititiŋetekec.”
Ido Saul, ka kes, ka ituŋa kere luka Isirael, kojaas aditor naka Ela, ejiosi ka Ipilisitian.
Konyou Daudi tupuruc sek, kinyeinia ekejokon amerekekin, kitin iboro, kolot kwape kieorakinia Yese; kodol aibois naka agalin, napedakun ajore ejie, kokutas ikodeta ejie.
Kiderakinos Isirael ka Ipilisitian, kotereikinos ajore ka ajore.
Kinyek Daudi ikeboro kakan naka ekedaran iboro, kodinirir mama ejai aiore, kolot kiyoga ikeinaean.
Napiyalaete kakes, koany, kodakun etikadedenan ie, Epilisitiat loka Gas, ekekiror Goliat, konyou kokokoron luka Ipilisitian, kinera kwape kejaatar akiro kwa: kiira Daudi.
Kosodete ituŋa kere luka Isirael, keanyut ekesa ie, kokerata kokuriakaros noi.

Kobalas ituŋa luka Isiracl ebe, “Ianyut etuŋanan ŋol loadoku? Abeit adorit Isirael ŋes adokunia: asa arai kear ituŋanan ŋes, itabari ekabaka kabar naepol, einakini da akokuke, ido ituluori ekek loka papake loka aijamam kotoma Isirael.”

Kosodi kinera Daudi kituna luedunyatar ebwoete atiar, “Ikonakinio ai ituŋanaa yeneari Epilisitiat lo, kolema amorosit kotoma Isirael? Naarai ŋes iŋai Epilisitiat lo lomam ekepitai, adorit ajore naka Edeke lokajaran?”
Kobonokis ituŋa kobalas ebe, “Ikonakinio nen ituŋanan yeneari ŋes.”

Kiira Eliab onaeeke lokapolon kwape enerar kituna; kinep anyunyura naka Eliab aluikin Daudi, kobala ebe, “Kanukinyo ibunio ijo da? Ido iŋai inyeinia amerekekin kwa adis kais? Ajeni akoniwononut, ka epali lokotaukon, naarai ibunit aanyun ejie.”
Kobala Daudi ebe, “Ekonak bo eoŋ ai kwana? Mam akirot?”
Kinyek ŋes kibelokin mama ejai ece, kinera akiro kwape kakwa; kobonokis bobo ŋes ituŋa kwape kebononokinioto nusodit.
Kiirar akiro nukinera Daudi, kitejenunai Saul; konyaraarai ŋes.
Kotema Daudi Saul atiar, “Kinyek etau loka irunanan aiurunun kanuken; elosi ekonibulesit ejie kEpilisitiat ŋol.”
Kotema Saul Daudi atiar, “Mam ipedori airiamakin kEpilisitiat ŋol ejie kaŋes; naarai irai ijo isapat, konye ŋol ekajiot ameun keitelepaneke.”
Kotema Daudi Saul atiar, “Ecokienenei ekonibulesit amerekekin nuka papake; nakebunenenoo eŋatuny, arai edubu, koyana imerekek yenikosipan.
Kalomanari, katupari, kenomi kademuni kaitukuke; keebwokokin, ketini kopenekike, kenom, kaari.
Abu ekonibulesit kinom eŋatuny ka edubu kere: ikonakini nen Epilisitiat ŋol lomam ekepep bala ediopet kakesi, naarai edorit aiore naka Edeke lokajaran.”
Kotema Daudi atiar, “EJAKAIT loabu ketajar kabelekeka nuka eŋatuny, ka abelekeka nuka edubu, ketajari da kakan naka Epilisitiat kanol.” Kotema Saul Daudi atiar, “Kolot, ejauni Edeke kajo.”
Kitanap Saul Daudi inapeneke, kidokok aboko naka aisinit akouke, kitanap ekooti loka aisinit.
Koenik Daudi ekekileŋ anapitoke; kitetemo alosit; naarai mam anaikinit, Kotema Daudi Saul atiar, “Mam apedori alosit kalu; naarai mam lem anaikinit.” Kolaca Daudi kes.
Kitin ekebela kakanike, koseu alica akany nuerurut kosamai, kibwaik oriagike lokicokis lokejaatar, toma ocoeke; kojai da akeporocet akanike; kikunyak Epilisitiat.
Kobunok Epilisitiat koapik Daudi; kinarenikinit etuŋanan loetinenenei ekebuku.
Kenolenol Epilisitiat, koany Daudi, komen; naarai kerai isapat, ikarenan, ido itemel.
Kotema Epilisitiat Daudi atiar, “Arai kereka eoŋ ekiŋok, ibuni neajai kibelai?” Kilam Epilisitiat Daudi kama ejaas idekesioke,
Kotema Epilisitiat Daudi atiar, “Bia neajai, kakorak akonikuan akweny nuka apak, ka itiaij luka ais.”
Kotema Daudi Epilisitiat atiar, “Ibuni ijo neajai kekilen, ka eliru, ka akwara; konye eoŋ abunit mama ijai kokiror loka EJAKAIT loka ajoresio, Edeke loka ajoresio nuka Isirael nuidorit.

Kikorakini lolo EJAKAIT akanika; kenomi jo, ajepari da akonikou; ido akorakini lolo akweny nuka apak, ka itian luka amagoro, atesin nuka ajore naka Ipilisitian; kojenut akwapin kere ebe ejai Edeke toma Isirael:
Kojen teni atukot na kere ebe mam EJAKAIT itajari kekilen ka akwara; naarai ejie erai loka EJAKAIT, ŋes da kikorakini yes akanikosi.”
Kosodi kanen, kenyou Epilisitiat, kobu kikunyak airiamakin kaDaudi, kisunya Daudi, kodinirir neejai aiore airiamakin kEpilisitiat.
Kirupa Daudi akan oriagike, kolem alicait, kiiliil, koporocik, kocam Epilisitiat oreeteke; koloma alicait oreeteke, kibiror ebuburia,
Kipiko Daudi kwaŋin Epilisitiat kaporoeet ka alicait, kocam Epilisitiat, koar; konye komamei ekileŋ kakan naka Daudi.
Kosodi konemesiar Daudi, kieak Epilisitiat, kitin ekekileŋ, kout kakuraruke, koar, kojep akekou. Keanyut Ipilisitian ebe atwana ekadedenanikec, kokerata.
Konyout ituŋa luka Isirael ka luka Yuda, ibwoŋas, korukoriata Ipilisitian aitodol neidolio Gat, korutei luka Ekuron. Kibironokinos Ipilisitian lukimusuŋitai orot loebei Saarim, kiton Gat, ka Ekuron.
Kobonut idwe luka Isirael karukitor Ipilisitian, konatata iidukurunukee.
Kolem Daudi akou naka Epilisitiat koyau Yerusalem; konye kinadak lujiisike owemake.
Keanyu Saul Daudi elosi asurokin Epilisitiat, kotema Abiner ekapolon loka aiore atiar, “Abiner, okoku lokanai esapat ŋol?” Kobala Abiner ebe, “Kwape ejaria ekonitau, wu ekabaka, mam ajeni.”
Kotema ekabaka atiar, “Kinit iŋai bo papa loka esapat kaŋol.”
Napebonuni Daudi kaiar Epilisitiat, koyana Abiner ŋes, koyana mama ejai Saul kitinite akou naka Epilisitiat,
Kotema Saul ŋes atiar, “Iŋai bo papakon, ijo esapat?” Koboŋok Daudi atiar, “Arai eoŋ okoku loka ebulesitikon Yese Ebetelekemit.”
